description: Test your checkout: Add a 100% off code and our agent buys your plan with it. A short private drive of your product's pay step: our agent signs up, buys your plan with your 100% off code (or in your checkout's test mode), uses one paid feature, cancels and deletes the account; the report comes by email. Free for a product you've proved yours (verify_claim); a product you've added but not proved counts with the free checks. One at a time, 2 per domain (its subdomains included) every 30 days.

kind.description: code: a one-use 100% off code; sandbox: a login to your checkout's test mode or sandbox (only for a product you've proved yours)

tool.description: Your product's directory slug, if listed

url.description: Your product's address, e.g. https://acme.com (or tool)

value.description: The code (6 to 64 letters, digits, dots, dashes or underscores) or the login
